description: Fixed-first-coordinate asymptotics and nonintegral staircase for the labeled quadrant-lattice least-reachable-chip invariant.
integrity: Exact recurrence, generating-function proof, localized floor-loss estimate, rational-arithmetic checker and independent finite labelled-firing simulation are included. The theorem itself has no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The first coordinate is fixed; the nonintegral staircase excludes integer limits; the finite initial-chip budget and two-coordinate scaling are not addressed; historical priority requires external review.
title: Fixed-row threshold and staircase laws for labeled chip-firing on the quadrant lattice
